row:
Welcome to my channel! As a working equine massage therapist, I am keen to share content in an effort to help promote and educate horse owners, trainers, riders or anyone on the real benefits massage can bring to horses. 

Just like athletes, horses are prone to strains, injuries and muscle pain, stiffness and discomfort. Massage can help decrease the chances of these occurring and help to preserve the longevity of the equine athlete helping him to perform optimally and happily and for longer.
